phase: ## Phase S5: Page proofs for Daniel
summary: Round 2 adds 8 adversarial Vitest tests and 9 Python P16 probes. All pass at the committed head. No implementation defect was found. The new tests close review A F24 and attack the 8 pt floor cascade, unit format, look scope, hero width, step-header gap, and P16 boundaries.
evidence: HEAD equals role_base_sha 1d66cd0f before work. After the test-only commit HEAD is 8ae1bb259d8d59e64b246233274b5739164685f1. git status on dashboard/lib, dashboard/templates, content/primary, and pnpm-lock.yaml is empty. Production is unchanged from the role base.

The first command ran the Thai filter on synthetic JSON: 2 th keys dropped, 1 Thai string dropped, THAI_REMAINING 0. Both new files hold 0 characters in U+0E00 to U+0E7F. No proof HTML, page image, PDF text, or lesson JSON was displayed.

The new chibi-quest-print-floor.adversarial.test.ts holds 8 tests. It proves the 8 P16 markers come from rendered body class attributes after style blocks are stripped, not from stylesheet text (review A F24). The control bodyClassCount(getChibiQuestStyles(), marker) is 0 for all 7 markers.
A specificity-and-importance-aware resolver checks the 8 P16 groups, 6 labels, and the Thai gloss at or above 10.67 px. It requires plain px units, so pt, em, rem, percent, calc, and var values fail.

Mutation controls inside the tests pass: a later higher-specificity 9px rule, a later 9px !important rule, a dropped collection-item label selector, a 60mm hero width, and a 1mm step-header margin each resolve below the guard. These prove the tests are not vacuous.

The hero test requires the literal 84.8mm width, the 100% max-width, and a plain absolute width unit. The step-header test requires a plain 4mm margin-top within 3 to 5 mm. Both reject calc, vw, and percent unit tricks.
The scope test requires the classic styles.ts to hold no .look-chibi-quest rule and compares SHA-256 digests of styles.ts and both golden files against phase base 04275398.

The new test-checks-p16-adversarial.py holds 9 probes. All pass: the 7.94 pt Latin fixture fails, 7.95, 7.96, and 8.0 pass at the 7.95 pt threshold; an empty Ghostscript XML gives no spans and check_p16 returns False; an oblique Latin font name triggers the italic guard; a plain Latin font name is the passing control.
Targeted heavy-run exits 0: 4 files pass, 33 tests pass, 0 fail. Capture: adversarial-s5-1d66cd0f.txt. The 8 new tests are included.
Python probe run exits 0: 9 probes pass, 0 fail, RESULT: PASS, THAI_IN_OUTPUT 0.
npx eslint on the new test file and npx tsc --noEmit both exit 0 after one HTMLElement type annotation was added. No production file was edited.

The full suite exceeded the 10-minute shell timeout and did not finish. It showed one unrelated failure, storytime-print-card-kit-match.test.ts G-P8-R4. That test was rerun alone and fails independently at HEAD with exit 1 on symbolic-link HOME masking. My two additive test files cannot affect that storytime test.

A4 is not applicable: this repository has no tests/ directory or all-tilde marker implementation. A5 was not reopened: the S5 plan holds no unverified all-checks-pass claim in this round. A7 is not applicable to P16: checks.py holds no banned-term negation filter in the P16 path.

No video, storytime-song, render.mjs, raw.json, strategy or review log, proof HTML, or review-a/review-b 1d66cd0f file was staged.
No implementation defect surfaced, so nothing is routed to Green. Any later implementation commit invalidates this result and requires the adversarial gate to rerun.
